headline: Iran hardens its nuclear stance and continues to blackmail international shipping in «Hormuz»
summary: Iran kept its hardline nuclear stance on Sunday, rejecting even a temporary suspension of uranium enrichment. The threat to international shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continues.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major transit route for seaborne oil, so threats to shipping there are closely watched by energy markets and insurers.
why_moved: Threats to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk of disruption to crude flows, which typically lifts oil prices.
